summary: Approximately 83,600 km² and about 9.9 million people (2020), from Wikidata's Q878 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "United Arab Emirates", at revision 1375575113, opens: "The United Arab Emirates (UAE), also known simply as the Emirates, is a country in West Asia, situated at the eastern end of the Arabian Peninsula. It is a federal semi-constitutional monarchy made up of seven emirates, with Abu Dhabi serving as its national capital. The UAE borders Oman to the east and northeast, and Saudi Arabia to the south and southwest." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 696 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1971 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Abu Dhabi. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1971-12-02. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
